headline: Binance has started reopening withdrawals, Bitcoin first, with its full reserves report due by Monday.

market.asOf: Read at about 07:57-07:59 UTC Sun 1 Nov (14:57 Bangkok). BTC and SOL from CoinGecko; ETH from CoinMarketCap. CoinMarketCap showed BTC near $77,142 and down about 1.75% over 24h, so the two sites disagree on bitcoin's 24h direction. Use the live prices at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 36 out of 100 on CoinMarketCap's Fear & Greed Index (Fear). CoinGecko's own gauge read 46, Neutral.

stories.title: Binance withdrawals are partly back, Bitcoin first
stories.summary: Binance began reopening withdrawals shortly after 06:00 GMT on Sunday, starting with the Bitcoin network, and has since opened more networks. It says it has now covered 95% of the roughly $6.3B stolen in the hack. A full Proof of Reserves report (a public check that customer balances are fully backed) is due by Monday 2 Nov.
points: Binance's status page said the planned withdrawals began shortly after 06:00 GMT Sunday, per Reuters via Investing.com; Binance said on X the Bitcoin network opened first, per AFP via Malay Mail.
ETH, USDT and USDC on Ethereum, and BNB, USDT and USDC on BNB Smart Chain have also reopened, with more to follow in phases, per TechFlow citing Binance.
Binance says it has covered 95% of the $6.3B stolen; the last 5% is less liquid tokens, per Reuters. These are Binance's own figures.
Binance warned of possible delays or failed withdrawals in the first hours because of heavy traffic, per Bitcoin Sistemi.
Co-CEO Richard Teng said a full Proof of Reserves report is due by Monday 2 Nov, per TokenPost.

stories.title: North Korea named as the hacker; laundering slowed, Tron hit
stories.summary: The FBI says North Korea's TraderTraitor group carried out the theft and expects more laundering. THORChain, a swap network the launderers used, paused most swaps after a glitch, which slowed them down. Tron's TRX token has fallen below its pre-hack price.
points: The FBI said North Korea's TraderTraitor unit was behind the hack and expects "further laundering," per Reuters via Investing.com.
Total stolen differs by source: Chainalysis puts it at $6.4B, per The Block; Reuters reports $6.3B.
THORChain halted swaps on most of its bridges after an Ethereum block rewrite (a reorg) made it refund a 10 ETH deposit twice; Chainalysis said this delayed the laundering, per TokenPost.
TRX was at $0.302 late on 31 Oct, down 8.3% in 24 hours and below its pre-hack level of about $0.331, per CryptoTicker.

stories.title: A red October ends, with US midterms on Tuesday
stories.summary: Bitcoin ended October lower after trading above $87,000 earlier in the month. On Tuesday 3 Nov the US votes in midterm elections that shape who takes up the stalled CLARITY Act on crypto market rules, and the hack has added calls in Washington for exchange rules.
points: October was set to be bitcoin's second straight red month, with BTC near $77,000 on 31 Oct after trading above $87,000 earlier in the month, per crypto.news.
Trump said his administration is looking into the Binance hack, and the Digital Chamber urged Congress to give the CFTC authority over exchanges, per The Block.
The CLARITY Act's Senate vote to start debate failed on 15 Sep, per CoinDesk.

sources.label: The Block: calls for crypto rules

briefs.title: Which coins are in phase one
briefs.summary: BusinessToday lists phase-one withdrawals as including BTC, ETH, BNB, TRX, SOL, XRP, DOGE, TON, AVAX and SUI, plus USDT and USDC.

briefs.title: How the hackers got in
briefs.summary: Reuters reports the attack began with a compromised laptop and malware built to delete evidence, and most of the theft took about 20 minutes.

briefs.title: Company may sell its bitcoin
briefs.summary: Nasdaq-listed Next Technology Holding authorized selling or borrowing against about 5,833 BTC, citing the Binance hack and quantum-computing risk, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Chainalysis customer data accessed
briefs.summary: Chainalysis said a hacker using AI-agent techniques accessed customers' names, emails and user IDs, and says it is unrelated to the Binance hack, per The Block.

briefs.title: DeFi websites hijacked
briefs.summary: About a dozen DeFi websites registered with Name.com were hijacked with a wallet-draining kit, with about $138K stolen, per The Block.
